audit_findings.8_avoid_structure_state: Avoid blocks exist in style_prompt_system.py, but not audited by a dedicated validator.
audit_findings.9_camera_library_state: Camera move strings exist, but validation to reject multiple contradictory moves per scene is missing.
audit_findings.10_company_style_image_reference: assets/style_reference/company_art_direction.png exists and is visually verified, but video_generation_tool.py does not formally pass it to image-to-video providers or record capability truthfully.
audit_findings.11_style_selection_per_scene: Storyboard has partial style assignment, but must adhere to Step 7 defaults (Hook: deep_diorama, Overload: deep_diorama, Typography: locked_stage, Crowd: deep_diorama, Data: flat_parallax, Trader: deep_diorama, Product: flat_parallax, CTA: locked_stage).
